title: D365 Opportunity High-Fidelity UI Gap Audit

evidence.evidenceLimit: The current test implementation was audited from unpublished FormXML/FormJSON and metadata. Pixel-level comparison requires a later rendered preview after the form and process are made available in an App.

form.name: AI Gateway Opportunity Demo - Full Replica

aigw_annualactualrevenue.result: Not displayed; must be added read-only when the Actual Management entry form is built.

customReplicaBpf.name: 销售流程 - AI Demo Full Replica

businessRule.name: AI Gateway Full Replica - Required - Opportunity

gapMatrix.reference: Summary screenshot shows annual actual totals as locked values.
gapMatrix.gap: A plugin-derived parent total can be manually overwritten from the Full Replica form.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Make the Full Replica control read-only; keep aigw_yearrevenueactual_base read-only and keep aigw_yearrevenueactualcny absent.

gapMatrix.reference: The reference Actuals grid exposes annual and April-March monthly values through a related Actual Management record.
gapMatrix.current: The only active Actual Management Main Form contains only aigw_name.
gapMatrix.gap: Users cannot enter the 12 monthly Revenue/GP/MP values or verify the related Opportunity and currency.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Build an Actual Management Main Form with fiscal April-March sections; add aigw_annualactualrevenue as read-only.

gapMatrix.reference: Every reference screenshot shows a two-stage Chinese process: 授予资格 then 案件关闭.
gapMatrix.current: The matching custom BPF is Draft/Inactive and not in an App; the active managed Sales Process has four English stages.
gapMatrix.gap: The rendered process will not match the reference until a separately governed activation/App/order phase is completed.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Complete R2E-1C, verify all intended steps, then use separate activation, security, process-order, and App gates. Do not modify the managed Sales Process.

gapMatrix.reference: Reference screens are usable record pages inside a model-driven App.
gapMatrix.current: Full Replica is Inactive, non-default, unpublished, and not included in an App.
gapMatrix.gap: No release candidate can be visually validated in the target App yet.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Keep this state during repair; resolve all P0 gaps before the separate publish and App-inclusion gates.

gapMatrix.reference: Visible order is 受注确度, 是否预算内, 负责人.
gapMatrix.current: FormXML order is 是否预算内, 受注确度, ownerid; owner 1033 label is Owner.
gapMatrix.gap: Field order and base-language owner label differ.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Reorder the three header cells and align the owner base label without changing the fields.

gapMatrix.reference: Tabs are 摘要, 预算, 实绩, 产品, 文件, 相关.
gapMatrix.current: The five form tabs are 摘要, 预算, 实绩, Products, Files; Related remains system navigation rather than a normal tab.
gapMatrix.gap: Products and Files are English in the base label.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Use 产品 and 文件 for the base-language tab labels; continue preserving Related as system navigation.

gapMatrix.reference: Header values use ordinal labels such as 02: A and 01: 预算内.
gapMatrix.current: Win probability options are A/B/C/D/Y/Z and budget options are 预算内/预算外 without ordinal prefixes.
gapMatrix.gap: Visible option labels do not faithfully match the reference.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Audit value-to-label semantics before any label change; add localized display labels only under a dedicated Choice gate.

gapMatrix.reference: Business choices use one numbered set per field.
gapMatrix.current: aigw_opportunitytype and aigw_casestage contain both earlier English values and separate numbered Chinese values.
gapMatrix.gap: Duplicate semantic option families can produce inconsistent Designer and runtime choices.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Resolve the authoritative option family without deleting or rewriting values during a UI-only phase.

gapMatrix.reference: The grid spans annual total, April-March Revenue and GP columns, followed by audit columns.
gapMatrix.current: The default view has six summary columns and no monthly columns.
gapMatrix.gap: The subgrid does not reproduce the visible monthly overview.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Create a high-fidelity Actuals subgrid view with the confirmed monthly column set and widths; retain the current concise view as an optional selector if useful.

gapMatrix.reference: The screenshot proves a related-record grid with one row and horizontal scrolling.
gapMatrix.current: A standard related-record subgrid exists and points to the correct table, relationship, and active view.
gapMatrix.gap: The record entry form is incomplete, and the screenshot does not prove inline editing.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Keep the related-record subgrid architecture. Use row-open Main Form entry unless the user confirms the source grid is editable.

gapMatrix.reference: The source intentionally mixes Chinese with Sales Person Info, Timeline, POL&POD and some English option values.
gapMatrix.current: The same pattern is partly present, but system labels and some options follow different language rules.
gapMatrix.gap: The mix is not yet governed field by field.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Create an approved label matrix instead of blanket-translating every English string.

gapMatrix.reference: The source uses a very wide horizontal grid with truncated headings and a scrollbar.
gapMatrix.current: The concise six-column view is easier to scan but not faithful.
gapMatrix.gap: High fidelity and day-to-day usability pull in different directions.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Provide a faithful monthly view plus a concise operational view through the view selector.

gapMatrix.reference: These navigation surfaces are present but not evidenced as active business workflows.
gapMatrix.current: Product and Documents system structures are preserved; Related remains navigation.
gapMatrix.gap: No functional replication gap is proven.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Retain without adding product or SharePoint scope.

gapMatrix.reference: Screenshots show one April-March row but do not establish multi-year behavior.
gapMatrix.current: The first version enforces at most one Actual Management row per Opportunity.
gapMatrix.gap: Future fiscal-year history is out of scope.
gapMatrix.recommendation: Keep the one-record rule for this release and revisit only with a fiscal-year requirement.

requiresUserConfirmation: Whether the source Actuals grid supports inline editing or only opens the Actual Management record form.
Whether monthly MP fields must appear in the grid; the supplied screenshots visibly prove Revenue and GP but not MP.
The exact BPF data steps and required flags; the screenshots show stage names and order but not the expanded step list.
Whether the source command should allow creating a new Actual Management record, linking an existing one, or both.
Whether the Actual Management Main Form should use four quarterly sections with three metric columns, or another entry layout.
Whether audit columns Created By/On and Modified By/On must remain in the default high-fidelity grid.
Whether the visible Actuals section heading should remain 实绩 or be hidden, because the screenshot mainly shows the grid surface.
